_comment: Curated per-adapter fidelity table. This file is DATA, not code: services/support_matrix.py loads and validates it, tests assert it covers the discovered adapter set exactly, and no agent name is hardcoded in Python for it. Each entry's 'basis' cites where in the adapter/normalizer source the values were read from. 'emits_usage_events': false marks providers whose source can never yield billable events (with the reason in 'notes') — the adapter↔normalizer parity test reads it.

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.notes: Anthropic usage reports no reasoning/thinking token split, so reasoning attribution is unavailable by design (never fabricated).
claude.basis: normalize/claude.py — message.usage carries no reasoning split

codex.label: Codex CLI

resume.verified: codex resume --help on a real install, 2026-07-10

codex.notes: OpenAI-shape usage; the reasoning token split is attributed.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.notes: Token counts fall back to a length estimate when the source omits them, and there are no cache-token fields; tool calls are not surfaced as a structured list.
cursor.basis: cursor.py docstring — explicit tokenCount preferred, else len//4 with cost_source=estimated; Record.tools=() (cursor.py:376)

cursor-agent.label: Cursor Agent
cursor-agent.notes: Text transcripts; token counts are estimated from length.

cline.label: Cline
cline.notes: Per-turn token and cost totals are exact, but tool calls and file touches are folded into message text, not attributed structurally.
cline.basis: cline.py — ui_messages carry tokensIn/Out/cacheWrites/Reads + explicit cost; Record.tools=() (cline.py:213)

kilocode.label: KiloCode
kilocode.notes: Shares the Cline parser: exact token/cost totals, but no structured tool-call or file-touch attribution.

roocode.label: Roo Code
roocode.notes: Shares the Cline parser: exact token/cost totals, but no structured tool-call or file-touch attribution.

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.notes: Reasoning tokens are folded into the output count, not attributed separately.

qwen.label: Qwen Code
qwen.notes: Reasoning (thinking) tokens are folded into the output count, not attributed separately.
qwen.basis: qwen.py — usageMetadata; thoughtsTokenCount folds into output_tokens

gemini.label: Gemini
gemini.notes: Reasoning (thoughts) tokens are folded into the output count, not attributed separately.
gemini.basis: gemini.py — tokens.output + tokens.thoughts folded into output

copilot.label: Copilot
copilot.notes: Output tokens fall back to an estimate when the source omits them.
copilot.basis: copilot.py:24 — output tokens, or an estimate when output is missing

codeium.label: Codeium
codeium.notes: Discovery stub — no records are decoded yet, so no usage events can exist by design.

continue.label: Continue
continue.notes: Token counts are estimated; tool calls are not surfaced as a structured list.

droid.label: Droid
droid.notes: Session token totals are distributed across assistant turns; the reasoning split is an estimate.
droid.basis: normalize/droid.py:122 reasoning_tokens=thinking; session totals distributed evenly

kiro.label: Kiro
kiro.notes: No token usage in the source; counts are estimated from content length.

antigravity.label: Antigravity
antigravity.notes: Per-message text and tokens are encrypted at rest; only plaintext metadata (titles, workspaces, CLI prompts) is surfaced — no billable events can exist by design.

grok.label: Grok

resume.note: no id-based resume in the grok CLI; --continue resumes the working directory's most recent session

grok.notes: No token usage in the source; counts are estimated from content length.
